how-to-add-funds.title: How to add funds on the website?

content.p1: To add funds, press the ‘+’ sign next to your balance and choose the method that fits you, then fill the empty spaces with what is required.
content.p2: If you are making a deposit via crypto-currencies, such as Ethereum, you should copy the address you are given and send the money to that address. The address there is your personal deposit address for WaxPeer.
